title: SOVABIDS: EEG-to-BIDS conversion software focused on automation, reproducibility and interoperability
description: SOVABIDS is an open-source tool for converting EEG data into the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) using human-readable YAML configuration files.

creators.name: Narayanan, Aswin
creators.affiliation: Australian National Imaging Facility, The University of Queensland
